name: Ultimate Obby Challenge
desc:
Welcome to Ultimate Obby Challenge 🎮

In this game you can find out how good you are at parkour 
and become better! 

If you bought the starterpack before 11-7-2025 you may didnt get the 25 wins, We're sorry for that. If you join the game again you will get the 25 Wins + 5 extra Wins, if you have any questions let it us know in the community.

If you enjoyed the game you can give the game a like! 👍

thanks for playing 🥳
